title: A deletion tick's worker should run the full declared gate before reporting done
body: wj6's own description notes both epic-yoh gate failures were deletions whose dependents lived outside the files the tick declared (a vendored contract, a test harness), so the per-tick tests passed while the integrated gate failed. The check belongs at dispatch/planning time: a tick whose declared touch set deletes anything should have its worker prompt require running the full declared gate before STATUS: DONE, or the admission should run it. wj6 left this out as planning guidance outside its acceptance.
